title: Verify: config, createGame and events use only 3.90 APIs unit tests
summary: Mocked-phaser tests for config, factory and event bus imports
description: Write tests/phaser390Config.test.ts with phaser mocked via vi.mock. Assert the config shape, the createGame wiring and that the source files reference no Phaser 4-only symbols.
acceptance_criteria: Given the mocked phaser, when buildGameConfig is called, then type is AUTO, size is 640x360 and pixelArt is true.
Given source text of config.ts, createGame.ts and events.ts read with node:fs, when scanned, then none matches /Filters|enableFilters|setFilter|Phaser\.Renderer\.WebGL\.Renderer\.Filters/.
Given events.ts source, when scanned, then it has no import from 'phaser'.
technical_constraints: phaser mocked; fs reads of repo source files only

steps.action: Create the test file. vi.mock('phaser') returning default {AUTO:0, Scale:{FIT:3, CENTER_BOTH:1}, Game: vi.fn()}. Test 1: buildGameConfig(document.createElement('div'), []) gives type 0, width 640, height 360, render.pixelArt true, scale.mode 3. Test 2: createGame passes buildGameConfig output to the mocked Game constructor. Test 3: read src/phaser/config.ts, createGame.ts and events.ts with readFileSync and expect no match for the Phaser 4 filter regex; expect events.ts not to contain "from 'phaser'".
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaser390Config.test.ts
